about: The fork's feature checks (scripts/fork-checks.ts): for each fork feature the owner keeps, the package, its test files (relative to the package) and the request that last proved it. bun run daily's upstream merge runs them on the merged tree before it pushes, and a fork lane's round gate runs them with `bun scripts/fork-checks.ts --fork <checkout>`. An expectation names one test that is red on a host whose condition it declares (the version of the first bash on PATH, read at run time) for a reason outside the fork; the test still runs, and passing there makes the check red, so a stale expectation cannot stay. No entry skips a file.

expectations.test: real-shell compound syntax > bash: printf '%s' "$(probe() case value in value) scan_probe;; *) scan_other;; esac; probe)"
expectations.reason: bash 3.2.57 (macOS's /bin/bash, the first bash on the test's PATH) rejects a function whose body is a case statement inside a command substitution; upstream's own test, red there before and after each merge (upstream-merge-1122 r1, known gap 2; shell-restart-notice r1). Measured on the Mac with GNU bash 3.2.57(1)-release.
